rules: Paper only. No real money is wagered.
Moneyline calls lock before puck drop (target 60-75 minutes; each call shows its actual lead), are timestamped, and are never edited. A missed game is never backfilled.
Prop bets: quarter-Kelly on our blended probability, capped at 1% of bankroll a bet, priced against the book at lock and scored against the closing line.
Each prop market is read at 100 scored bets (pre-registered): CONTINUE, KILL or INCONCLUSIVE. A killed market stops betting.
Every miss is classified the next morning: LUCK (the process favored the result we called), MODEL, or INPUTS (wrong goalie or lineup at lock).
